title: UltraEdit · 多方法图像编辑定性对比

description.zh: 输入、指令、掩码和多种生成结果采用可追踪的对齐网格，适合定性比较而不只陈列漂亮样例。
description.en: Source images, instructions, region cues and method outputs align in a consistent matrix to support fair qualitative reading.

zh: 需要展示图像编辑、补全、局部约束等任务的定性实验对照。
en: Building qualitative result grids for editing, inpainting or local visual-control tasks.

zh: 列与行的语义保持固定，局部编辑的目标区域有可见参照；相同输入的多种输出便于横向复查细节。
en: Keep semantics fixed across rows and columns; show edit-region context; align alternative outputs against identical source images.

zh: 只是定性案例，不能从几张精选图片推断平均性能或统计显著性。
en: Selected qualitative examples do not prove average superiority or statistical significance.
